explanation: Generated a five-point inclusive cos(theta*) scan at fixed W=1.700 GeV, Q2=1.500 GeV^2, and phi*=90 deg using the eta configuration defaults (EtaMAID model 3, 6.535 GeV electron beam, full O(alpha) correction, vcut=0.166 GeV^2). cos(theta*)=+/-1 is physically allowed, but it is an exact angular endpoint; the eta documentation's production grids avoid it (typically using +/-0.9 or +/-0.999), so verify numerical stability at the two endpoint points.
